The AILU story

Starting small. Caring deeply.

Event companies set the stage and leave. Performers perform and go. AILU connects them.

AILU is a new, founder-led event planning and hosting business based in Udupi. We believe a meaningful celebration starts with listening: to your ideas, your people and the feeling you want to create.

Personal attention. Clear plans. Room to grow.

A few things you might be wondering

Good questions. Clear answers.

How much does an event cost?

Every quotation depends on the occasion, guest count, location, duration and services required. Supplier costs, our fee and any agreed extras are explained in the quotation.

Can I book only hosting or coordination?

Yes. You can enquire about hosting, event-day coordination or broader planning support. We’ll agree exactly what is included before you book.

Can you arrange corporate entertainment and personal performances?

Yes. Tell us about your audience, occasion and preferred dance, music or activities. We’ll discuss a suitable programme and confirm the performers, preparation and technical needs before booking.

Do you work outside Udupi?

Yes, we consider selected bookings across South India. Location, travel, local partners and availability are discussed before confirmation.

Is submitting the form a confirmed booking?

No. We first discuss your requirements and check availability. Your booking is confirmed only after the scope, terms and required payment are agreed.

Do I need to be a perfect performer to express interest?

No. We welcome honest introductions from beginners and experienced performers. Share your style, strengths and any support you need. Collaborations depend on the event, preparation and suitability.

Are you hiring a full-time team?

AILU is currently founder-led. The team form collects interest from freelancers, vendors and future collaborators. It is not a promise of employment or an assignment.

Clear expectations

A little clarity. A lot of care.

Plain words on your privacy, enquiries and bookings.

Your details

When you send an enquiry or application, your answers are delivered to AILU through Netlify, the company that hosts this website, and sent to AILU’s inbox. A copy is kept in AILU’s private Netlify account. If you choose WhatsApp or email instead, the message goes directly from your own app.

We use what you send only to reply to you, and to plan your event if you book. We don’t publish it or sell it. If planning involves a partner, such as a decorator or performer, we’ll discuss what is shared with you first.

Please don’t send identity documents, financial details or other sensitive information. To correct or delete your details, email worldofailu24@gmail.com from the same contact details.

This website and your browser

There are no advertising or tracking cookies. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, so Google may see your device’s IP address when the page loads.

Enquiries and bookings

An enquiry is not a confirmed booking. Scope, performers, venue, suppliers, pricing, payment and cancellation terms are agreed with you in writing before anything is confirmed. This website never collects payments.

Images and illustrations

Concept images, illustrations and artwork on this website show ideas and inspiration. They are not photographs of completed AILU events or confirmed performers. Traditional art forms are discussed individually and presented with suitable performers.

Joining AILU

Adult performers, freelancers, vendors and event professionals can share their interest in working with AILU. Sharing your interest does not guarantee selection, employment or assignments. The sales and referral programme is currently closed, and no referral earnings or bonuses are offered.

Dreams, donations and rewards

Dreams you share are read in confidence and used only to see whether AILU, our partners or donors can help. Sharing a dream does not guarantee it can be fulfilled.

Online donations are not open yet, and this website does not collect any money. Registration and tax-receipt details will be published here before online giving opens.

AILU Rewards is not active yet. Hand points are a thank-you, not money, and only rules published on this website will apply.
